_doc: R round 5: matid colours (sRGB, exact) for the guide pass. Body/hair mats = hx.MATS (unchanged); the face mats appear only through the face textures (rig/face_tex or F's face/tex3d). 'skin' is the face base. P: treat them as ordinary materials (suggested ramps: eye_white W, iris h/g/L, lash K, mouth m/R, blush k). Round 5: F's extra mats added (iris_top, iris_low, brow, mouth_in, nose; F's suggested ramps: lash KKK, iris_top hhh, iris ggg, iris_low LLL, eye_white WWW, brow ggg, mouth mmm, mouth_in RRR, blush kkk, nose SSS). Round 5b: 'ramps' = explicit palette ramp (dark, base, light) per face mat. The m96 iris is brown-grey by design (h top, g mid, L low light); use these keys, not the hair/skin ramps.

textured._doc: R round 7: the illustration-textured head. Its guide matids (hair/skin/bow/eyes, classified from the illustration colours) take their colour from the 'tex' pass (unlit projected illustration, alpha = head mask) by E2 k-centroid, snapped to the palette. The rule only applies where tex alpha >= .5 (head group: hull + side locks), so body skin, hands and the obi are unaffected. 'allow' = palette chars each textured material may snap to: skin cells include the face features (W eye white, k blush, m mouth, h/g/L iris, K lash), so the face is not flattened to skin. 'ramps' = dark/base/light for any banding.
